PRM-2049-K7 · O0 · 1lPRM-2049-K7 · O0 · 1l

Reference codes in mono with slashed zero so people can type them back without guessing.
Signature
Nothing decorative: a heavy, tight page title, numbered steps in the display face at heading size, and reference codes in a mono that is easy to read aloud on the phone.
Use when
Government and council services, forms, utilities, transit, anything where people must finish a task under stress.
Turns into slop when
When a hero image or illustration is added to look friendly, when the green action colour is used for headings too, or when helper text goes grey.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
